input.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
input.rationale: Section 4.1 (p0024) is the only renewal provision: the Agreement auto-renews for successive one-year periods on each anniversary, which satisfies the 12-month renewal-term requirement, but the notice required to stop a renewal is ninety (90) days. That exceeds the fallback ceiling of a 60-day non-renewal notice window (and sits at the walk-away boundary), so the clause fails the fallback on a material term. Renewal carries no price-uplift mechanism — the fee is fixed at 30% of Net Sales above $11,000 per month (p0019) — so the price-cap element is met as drafted. We therefore made the single minimal change of shortening the window to sixty (60) days, landing the clause at the fallback. The absence of the preferred mechanics (30-day opt-out, HDI reminder 60 days before renewal, lesser-of-CPI-and-3% cap) is noted only as a gap short of preferred wording, not as a separate deviation; the Termination Payment in Section 4.2 is addressed under the termination-for-convenience rule.

mappings.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer's non-renewal notice window is no more than 60 days.
If renewal permits price increases, each increase is capped at 5 percent.
mappings.quote: The Company shall pay HDI thirty percent (3016) of the Net Sales in excess of Eleven Thousand Dollars ($11,000) per calendar month.

proposal.summary: Shorten the Section 4.1 non-renewal notice window from 90 days to 60 days.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We shortened the notice required to stop an automatic renewal from 90 to 60 days, which is our fallback position (our preferred position is 30 days with a 60-day renewal reminder from HDI). The one-year renewal term and the fixed fee (with no renewal uplift) are acceptable as drafted.

ops.oldText: ninety (90) days written notice to the other
ops.newText: sixty (60) days written notice to the other
